You need to buy AW7915-NP1, AW7915-NPD, or AW7916-NPD. :4G/5G modules we will put online soon.) *Supports Bluetooth, 802.11an/ac/ax WLAN via PCle, and prioritizes streaming services :with its hardware NAT engine and QoS (Wi-Fi 6E is optional). ===See also=== :;[[AsiaRF]] • [https://asiarf.com/product-category/wi-fi/wi-fi-platform/ Wi-Fi Platform] *[[AsiaRF AP7988-001]] • Wi-Fi 7 BE19000 Router Board *[[AsiaRF DP7986]] • Wi-Fi 6E AX6000 Router • [https://asiarf.com/product/wi-fi-6e-ax6000-mediatek-mt7986a-router/ PPage] *[[AsiaRF AP7622]](-001) • 5G/4G LTE Router Board • [https://asiarf.com/product/5g-4g-router-board-with-2-4ghz-wifi-gps-lora-iot-functions-by-mt7622-w-2-4ghz-wifi-ap7622-001-manufacturer/ PPage] *[[AsiaRF AP7622-WH1]] • 5G/4G LTE Router Board • [https://asiarf.com/product/%e3%80%90wi-fi-halow-expert-kit%e3%80%91ap7622-wh1-5g-4g-lte-router-board-with-2-4ghzwi-fi-halow-gps-lora-iot-functions-by-mt7622-w-2-4ghz-wi-fi-manufacturer-2/# PPage] *[[AsiaRF DP7622]] • Wi-Fi 6 HaLow Expert Kit • [https://asiarf.com/product/ap7622-wi-fi-halow-enterprise-gateway/ PPage] *[[AsiaRF AP7629]] • 5G/4G LTE Router Board • [https://asiarf.com/product/5g-4g-lte-security-router-board-ac1900-mtk-mt7629ba-3x3-dual-bands-dual-concurrent-dbdc/ PPage] :[[MediaTek]] MT7629BA @1.25GHz, AC1900 (3×3 DBDC) *[[AsiaRF DP7621-IL1]](-002) • Wi-Fi 5 Router Board • [https://asiarf.com/product/wifi-router-board-mt7621-rs232-rs485-ap7621-002/ PPage] :[[MediaTek]] MT7621A/MT7615N (DP7621-IL1) • [https://asiarf.com/product/ap7621-il1-wi-fi-router-board-11ac-wave2/ PPage] *[[AsiaRF AP7628-NN1]] • Wi-Fi Tiny IoT Router Board • [https://asiarf.com/product/wi-fi-tiny-iot-router-board-mtk-mt7628-vpn/ PPage] :[[MediaTek]] MT7628AN, 2T2R bgn (300Mbps), VPN, 3x LAN ==Images== __NOTOC__
